events.title: Gladiator Immortal Patch 0.5.25
events.summary: A small patch to fix the UI are Ultra Wide Monitors. Please note, this is currently just a patch to make the demo playable using ultra wide but we will roll out an improved version post Next Fest.Thanks to everyone who reported this issue.Please let us know via the discussions if any other issues are found around UI layout and resolutions along with any bugs found of course.Thanks,Birchwood Games

events.title: Gladiator Immortal - End of Play Test (Oct 4th)
events.summary: Thanks for everyone who has tried the Play Test and added/reported thoughts / comments and bugs. All appreciated !The Play Test will end today (October 4th).It has been running for approx. 1 month, initially to internal testers, then a larger set of external testers and then open to all for the last 8-9 days.
